preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or a valid TreeNode object.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root.left, root.right]) if root else True
preconditions.description: If root exists, its left and right children must be either None or valid TreeNode objects.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum_path(root, path) for path in get_all_leaf_to_root_paths(root))
postconditions.description: The returned value must be the maximum sum of any path from a leaf to the root.

postconditions.expression: return_value >= sum_path(root, path) for path in get_all_leaf_to_root_paths(root)
postconditions.description: The returned value must be at least as large as any leaf-to-root path sum in the tree.
